questions.text: What are my options for sending text alerts to employees if we don't have a developer or an IT department?
Our carrier email-to-text address stopped delivering messages. What do businesses switch to so automated alerts still reach phones?
Can I keep using Gmail to send staff alerts and have them arrive as normal texts, or do I need a separate texting app?
Is it better to send staff alerts from a texting app, from email-to-SMS, or from a paging service for a 30-person company?
Our booking system can only send emails. Is there a way to forward those automatically as SMS reminders to customers and staff?
